verdict.rationale: The CLI docs describe calling `codex exec` from scripts, repeatable workflows and CI pipelines, and describe running non-interactive commands [codex-docs-32, codex-docs-19, codex-docs-8]. Supporting pieces are documented: API-key auth [codex-gh-4], pre-set permissions so it can edit files and run commands without prompting [codex-docs-17], and cloud tasks triggered from GitHub, GitLab, Linear or Slack [codex-docs-1, codex-docs-2]. Missing for 10: detailed CI setup documentation (headless auth, output formats, exit codes) and independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.
